passing_score.verbatim: Each driver license test must be passed separately.

exam_facts.note: Handbook physical p11 (printed p9) lists separate vision, traffic-signs, knowledge and driving-skills tests and says each must be passed separately; the signs test requires identifying signs by color and shape and explaining each. It states no question count, passing score/percent, or time limit (full-text search for pass/percent/questions/correct found none) — nulls are genuine absences, not imported from memory.
